    - list:
      - listitem: Each step is a checkbox with aria-checked; the bar is a progressbar with the count as text
      - listitem: Any click or key press stops the automatic play, so it never fights the user

      - listitem: On mount the card settles in and the rows fade up one after another
      - listitem: Steps stay in place so nothing jumps; the counter rolls to the new number
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion every change is instant
